اقتصرا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَرَا (iqtaṣarā) /iq.ta.sˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اُقْتُصِرَا (uqtuṣirā) /uq.tu.sˤi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# اِقْتَصِرَا (iqtaṣirā) /iq.ta.sˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
